title: [CORE-01] Repo skeleton with contract stubs
acceptance: Folder layout from PRD Section 7; every module in Section 12 exists with the exact signatures and stub bodies returning fixed, realistic values; `main.py` serves `/health`, `/console` (placeholder page) and `/ws/console` (echoes utterances as `speak`); `requirements.txt`, `.env.example` (every variable in Section 7), `tests/test_smoke.py` committed; a teammate can clone, install and run it

title: [CORE-02] llm.py against Ollama
acceptance: Returns text or a validated tool call; temperature 0; `num_ctx` from config; malformed tool output retried once; works from every team machine

title: [CORE-03] LLM reliability test for autonomy
acceptance: 10 runs each of a `fill_field` call on a sample form and a `click` choice on a sample search-results snapshot; pass counts reported at CP2 (target 9/10 each); model choice recorded

title: [CORE-04] config.py
acceptance: All env vars from Section 7 with defaults; gate thresholds; blocked domains; sensitive keys

title: [CORE-05] Reference repo study
acceptance: `docs/REFERENCE_NOTES.md`, about 10 lines: structure, how the agent starts, browser connection, prompt and page-state ideas to borrow

title: [CORE-06] session.py state machine
acceptance: Allowed-transitions table; illegal transition raises; unit test proves COMMITTING is unreachable without `confirmed=True` and a `pending_action`; PAUSED and NEEDS_HUMAN_CHECK save and restore state

title: [CORE-07] profile.py encrypted profile
acceptance: Fernet with a PBKDF2 key from the PIN and a random salt; sensitive fields encrypted; wrong PIN raises `WrongPinError`; file outside the repo; unit tests

title: [CORE-08] tools.py schemas, executor and domain policy
acceptance: All tools from Section 12; placeholder substitution; `domain_allowed` blocks `BLOCKED_DOMAINS`; profile values typed only on approved or trusted domains; expected values recorded with type; irreversible elements stored as `pending_action`, never clicked; result strings contain no raw sensitive values; no submit or commit tool; unit tests with a stub page

title: [CORE-09] Site and intent resolution
acceptance: `resolve_target` maps aliases from `sites.json`, plain URLs and domains; otherwise the agent uses `web_search`; the destination domain is announced; tests for 5 phrasings

title: [CORE-10] Autonomous agent loop
acceptance: Step cap from config; snapshot and history trimmed to fit the context; page content labelled untrusted; one-phrase narration per step and a `step` event; failure counter with retry or alternative and `ask_user` after 2 failures; gate called before risky actions; human-check pause and resume; `stop` halts within one step; typed requests complete demo tasks A and B

title: [CORE-11] main.py integration
acceptance: WebSocket routing; command matcher before the agent; every event in Section 12 sent to the Console; refocus after actions; one command starts the full system

title: [CORE-12] Irreversible-action confirmation flow
acceptance: A held action triggers verify (for forms), read-back or `describe_pending`, a `pending` event and AWAITING_CONFIRM; "confirm" runs `commit_pending`; "no" or "change <field>" returns to ACTING; unit test proves nothing irreversible runs without "confirm"

title: [CORE-13] Final integration and freeze
acceptance: Demo tasks A and B pass twice in a row by voice on the demo machine; `demo-v1` tagged

title: [CORE-14] Start script and keyboard shortcut
acceptance: `scripts/start.ps1` and `scripts/start.sh` start the backend if it is not running (wait for `/health`), open the Console and agent browser, and do not start a second backend if run twice; `docs/START_KEY.md` explains binding the script to a keyboard shortcut with the OS (checked against current Windows and macOS documentation); pressing the key from another app brings the system up and the agent says it is ready

title: [UI-01] Handy setup on every demo machine
acceptance: Installed, models downloaded, hold-to-talk shortcut, permissions, paste settings tested; wired headset works; steps written in `SETUP.md`

title: [UI-02] Voice Console page
acceptance: Always-focused text box; 900 ms debounce or Enter sends `utterance`; shows status, live step log, transcript, masked field table, pending action and alerts from the Section 12 events; reconnects if the socket drops

title: [UI-03] Console accessibility
acceptance: Keyboard-only operation; Escape = stop; ARIA live region for agent messages; large text; high contrast; focus never leaves the text box; checked with VoiceOver or NVDA

title: [UI-04] Handy decision gate
acceptance: 10-utterance test plus focus test across 5 actions; result (pass or fail) posted at 20:30; notes whether the Console can stay a small always-on-top window and whether an OS-level refocus helper is needed; if Handy fails, notes whether a wake word is practical

title: [UI-05] Fallback STT (only if UI-04 fails)
acceptance: `WhisperSTT` with faster-whisper and silero-vad behind `STT`; switched with `STT_BACKEND=whisper`; 9/10 test passes

title: [UI-06] voice.py output and commands
acceptance: `PiperTTS` with `interrupt()`; `BrowserTTS` fallback; `match_command` covers every command in Section 12; `spoken_digits`; `words_to_digits`; unit tests for the text functions

title: [UI-07] Onboarding and PIN unlock
acceptance: Questions spoken one at a time; each answer read back and confirmed; sensitive values typed and hidden on screen; PIN set and confirmed; unlock works after restart; wrong PIN handled clearly

title: [UI-08] Voice polish
acceptance: Barge-in works; "stop" and "pause" work mid-task; "where am I" and "what can I say" answered; narration stays short; friendly error messages; five consecutive clean voice runs

title: [BRW-01] Mock portal
acceptance: `mock_site/portal/`: landing page with Apply link; form with tabs "Personal Details" and "Bank Details"; fields from Section 11; labels and `aria-invalid` errors; validation messages; help link opening a new tab; fake "I'm not a robot" step; **PIN code field silently drops its last digit**; Submit shows an acknowledgment number; a human can complete it

title: [BRW-02] browser.py controller and focus test
depends_on: none (start standalone, fit to the CORE-01 stub once merged)
acceptance: Headed Playwright with agent and Console windows; follows and announces new tabs; `switch_tab`, `close_tab`, `go_back`, `refocus_console`; `scripts/focus_test.py` reports Console focus across 5 clicks for UI-04

title: [BRW-03] perception.py snapshot and main text
acceptance: Ids and locators per contract; label fallbacks (aria-label, placeholder, nearby text, name/id); errors; one-paragraph summary; `main_text` returns readable article text without menus; iframe handling; size caps; correct JSON for every mock page and for one real Wikipedia article

title: [BRW-04] humancheck.py
acceptance: Detects the fake check, OTP fields, password fields and the mock checkout payment page; silent on normal pages; reports when the challenge is gone

title: [BRW-05] sites.json directory
acceptance: Entries for the mock portal, mock shop, mock search and 4 real sites (Wikipedia, a news site, a gov.in page, DuckDuckGo) with aliases, domain and trusted flag

title: [BRW-06] Real-site tests
acceptance: Snapshot and `main_text` on 3 real sites and the real search page; whether Playwright is blocked; findings and fallbacks in `docs/REAL_SITE_NOTES.md`

title: [BRW-07] CDP attach to the user's Chrome
acceptance: BROWSER_MODE=chrome starts the installed Chrome with remote debugging on 127.0.0.1 and the persistent AGENT_PROFILE_DIR and attaches over CDP with the same BrowserController interface; attach connects to a running Chrome; chromium stays the default fallback. Proof first: sign in to Gmail by hand once, close Chrome, reopen via the agent, still signed in (recorded in docs/REAL_SITE_NOTES.md). Voice Console is its own window of the same Chrome and scripts/focus_test.py passes in this mode. Task D on real Gmail: open inbox, open newest message, main_text reads it; gmail and my mail aliases in sites.json, trusted false. No automation-hiding flags and no fake user agent

title: [BRW-08] Irreversible-control flagging
acceptance: Every button and submit input gets `irreversible` and `kind` from text, form submit type and target hints (submit, pay, buy, place order, send, post, delete, accept); unit tests across all mock pages with no missed irreversible control

title: [BRW-09] Mock open-web pages
acceptance: `mock_site/web/`: search results page reading `?q=`, an article page, a shop with product list, cart and checkout (payment form for the hand-off); work with `SEARCH_URL` pointed at the mock search; also a mock inbox and message page for offline Task D tests

title: [JEV-01] Jev and jevals research
acceptance: `docs/JEV_NOTES.md`: access method, cost, real API, example call; backend decision (jev, llm or rules) posted by 19:00

title: [JEV-02] verifier.py
acceptance: Reads real values (inputs, dropdown text, checkboxes); type-aware normalisation (dates, phone with +91, Aadhaar grouping, case, spaces); unit tests catch the truncated PIN code and a missing required field

title: [JEV-03] readback.py and pending description
acceptance: Read-back chunks from actual values; digits separated; sensitive values masked to the last four; ends with the confirm or change instruction; `describe_pending` names the action, the site and any total shown; unit tests

title: [JEV-04] gate.py rules layer
acceptance: Risk classes from the Section 10 autonomy policy; block navigation to blocked domains; block profile fills on unapproved domains; first sensitive fill per domain returns `ask_user`; irreversible elements never return `proceed`; unit tests

title: [JEV-05] gate.py Jev layer
acceptance: Semantic checks (action serves the user's goal; right element or field for the value); thresholds from config; `ask_user` for a mid-confidence test case; an injected instruction on a page is not followed; switchable backend

title: [JEV-06] audit.py
acceptance: JSONL log; sensitive keys dropped automatically; test proves no raw values are written

title: [JEV-07] End-to-end tests
acceptance: Scripted typed runs of demo tasks A (mock search), B and C; planted trap caught; human check paused and resumed; nothing irreversible runs without "confirm"; pass or fail printed

title: [JEV-08] Demo script and deck
acceptance: `docs/DEMO.md` with the 3-minute script from Section 17; deck with problem, architecture, autonomy policy, safety layers, competition and roadmap

title: [JEV-09] Rehearsals and backup video
acceptance: Two full rehearsals on the demo machine and venue network; backup video of a clean run saved
